use default
use Raster.AXES
use Raster.IMAGE

gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int => if b == 0 then a else gcd(b, a % b) fi

yellowstone(count: int) -> LIST[int] is
    let terms = LIST([1, 2, 3])
    let used = SET([1, 2, 3])

    while terms.count < count do
        let previous = terms[terms.count - 1]
        let before_previous = terms[terms.count - 2]
        let candidate mut = 1

        while used.contains(candidate) \/
                gcd(candidate, previous) != 1 \/
                gcd(candidate, before_previous) == 1 do
            candidate = candidate + 1
        od

        terms.add(candidate)
        used.add(candidate)
    od

    terms
si

let terms = yellowstone(500)

let highest = terms
    |> reduce(0, (so_far, term) =>
        if term > so_far then term else so_far fi)

let points = terms
    |> index()
    |> map(term =>
        (x = cast double(term.index + 1), y = cast double(term.value)))
    |> collect_list()

let image = IMAGE(760, 470)

image.colour(90ub, 95ub, 110ub)
image.stroke(1.0)

let axes = AXES(image)

axes.x_title = "n"
axes.y_title = "a(n)"

axes.fit(0.0, 0.0, cast double(terms.count), cast double(highest) + 20.0)
axes.draw()

image.colour(170ub, 180ub, 205ub)
image.line(points)

image.colour(30ub, 70ub, 140ub)

for point in points do
    image.dot(point.x, point.y, 1.7)
od

image.write("yellowstone.png")

image.show("yellowstone.png")
